classification.difficultyReason: Extend the supplied first-row calculation to find change relative to each original amount and label the result as an increase or decrease.

inlines.text: Complete the table, showing percentage change.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Change}&=150-120\\&=30\\\%\text{ change}&=\frac{30}{120}\times100\\&=25\%\end{align*}$$
The positive change means a $25\%$ increase.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Change}&=20-12\\&=8\\\%\text{ change}&=\frac{8}{12}\times100\\&=\frac{200}{3}\%\\&=66.6\dot{6}\%\end{align*}$$
The positive change means a $66.6\dot{6}\%$ increase.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Change}&=70-140\\&=-70\\\%\text{ change}&=\frac{-70}{140}\times100\\&=-50\%\end{align*}$$
The negative change means a $50\%$ decrease.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Change}&=15-80\\&=-65\\\%\text{ change}&=\frac{-65}{80}\times100\\&=-81.25\%\end{align*}$$
The negative change means an $81.25\%$ decrease.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Change}&=270-120\\&=150\\\%\text{ change}&=\frac{150}{120}\times100\\&=125\%\end{align*}$$
The positive change means a $125\%$ increase.
